formDescription: First step of the FOI request wizard. Determines whether the applicant is requesting general (non-personal) government information or personal information about themselves, a dependant child, or another person. The answer drives which subsequent steps are shown.

request_type.title: What type of information are you looking for?
request_type.description: General information includes records of a non-personal nature (e.g. briefing notes, contracts, agreements). Personal information means recorded information about an identifiable individual (e.g. health care information, correctional records, employment history).

options.label: Personal information about yourself, a dependant child or another person
